meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加动态图文叠加层，同步字幕与画面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为访谈或播客视频添加专业图文卡片
copy.tagline_en: Add timed graphic overlays to videos, synced with transcript
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add professional graphic cards to interview or podcast videos

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 在一个已有的谈话类视频上,按说话内容自动配上设计好的图形卡片(如标题、引语、数据框、画中画等),并做成时间同步的动画叠加层,最后导出一个 MP4 视频,原来的视频画面保持不变。
howto.when: 当用户提到 "graphic overlays"、"on-screen graphics" 等关键词,或要求"包装/装饰我的视频"时触发。它只负责给已有视频叠加图形,不做纯字幕。

say.text: 给这段采访视频加上标题、引语和 lower-thirds 卡片。
say.note: Claude 会分析转录并设计同步的图形卡片。

say.text: 用竖版 9:16 给这个播客加数据标注和画中画。
say.note: 会按竖版画布重新排版图形。

say.text: 把这个 3 分钟的谈话视频包装一下,突出关键数字。
say.note: 自动推断卡片数量并生成动画叠加。

howto.what_en: Claude overlays timed, designed graphics (titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, PiP) onto an existing talking-head video, synced to the transcript, and renders an MP4; the original clip plays unchanged below.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords like "graphic overlays" or "on-screen graphics", or asks to "package / dress up my video". It only handles graphic overlays on existing videos, not plain subtitles.

say_en.text: Add title, quote and lower-third cards to this interview video.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the transcript and design synced graphics.

say_en.text: Package this podcast as a 9:16 vertical with data callouts and PiP.
say_en.note: It will reflow the graphics for the vertical canvas.

say_en.text: Dress up this 3-minute talk and highlight the key numbers.
say_en.note: It infers card count and generates animated overlays.
